lines.zh: 我沿着矿洞的支道慢慢走。
lines.en: I take my time down the mine's side tunnels.

lines.zh: 铜锈在我手肘上亮亮的。
lines.en: Copper verdigris glints on my elbows.

lines.zh: 我背着篓子，背带勒着肩。
lines.en: My basket strap cuts into my shoulder.

lines.zh: 脚下碎石多，我走得小心。
lines.en: Loose stones everywhere; I step carefully.

lines.zh: 我拐弯前先探头，怕撞见什么。
lines.en: I peer round each bend before turning.

lines.zh: 洞穴里回声大，脚步显得响。
lines.en: The cave echoes and my steps sound loud.

lines.zh: 我踩着矿车的轨道走，省力。
lines.en: I walk the cart rails. Easier going.

lines.zh: 墙上有铜矿的绿斑，我停下看。
lines.en: Green flecks of copper on the wall. I stop to look.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁走，避开深坑。
lines.en: I hug the rock wall to skirt the deep pit.

lines.zh: 篓子里的铜块互相碰，叮当响。
lines.en: The copper in my basket knocks and clinks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往上坡走，喘得厉害。
lines.en: I trudge uphill, breathing hard.

lines.zh: 我回头看看有没有跟着的。
lines.en: I look back to see if anything followed.

lines.zh: 我沿着水声走，那里凉快。
lines.en: I follow the sound of water where it's cool.

lines.zh: 我小步小步地挪，怕摔了铜。
lines.en: I shuffle in small steps so I don't drop the copper.

lines.zh: 走到岔口，我选了左边那条。
lines.en: At the fork I take the left way.

lines.zh: 我最后停在一处矿脉前面。
lines.en: At last I stop before a copper vein.

lines.zh: 我蹲在矿脉边，用指甲抠。
lines.en: I squat by the vein and pick at it with a nail.

lines.zh: 洞顶在滴水，滴在我耳朵上。
lines.en: Water drips from the roof onto my ear.

lines.zh: 我把铜块拿出来擦了擦。
lines.en: I take a copper lump out and rub it clean.

lines.zh: 火把的光晃，影子也跟着晃。
lines.en: The torchlight wavers and my shadow with it.

lines.zh: 我数了数篓子里有几块。
lines.en: I count what's in the basket.

lines.zh: 我抬头看洞顶，很高，看不见。
lines.en: I look up at the roof. Too high to see.

lines.zh: 我啃了一口干面包，很硬。
lines.en: I bite some dry bread. It's hard.

lines.zh: 有蝙蝠飞过，我缩了下脖子。
lines.en: A bat flits past; I duck my neck.

lines.zh: 我把锤子靠在腿上歇着。
lines.en: I rest the hammer against my leg.

lines.zh: 洞里安静，我听着自己的呼吸。
lines.en: The cave is quiet; I hear my own breathing.
I wind the rope round once more.

lines.zh: 我在等别的哥布林喊我。
lines.en: I'm waiting for another goblin to call me.
The smell of copper is strong here.
I trim the wick a little shorter.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸口袋，金币还在。
lines.en: I check my pocket. The coins are still there.
I'm wondering how much I'll get today.
Stay back. This vein is mine.
You're not a goblin, are you.
I back behind the mine cart.
I raise my hammer. Only raise it.
Your boots have copper stain on them.
Don't look in my basket.
Have you come to take my ore?
I've been digging here three days.
It's dark in here. Did you bring a light?
I speak softly. I don't want to draw others.
My nose is a bit red. Copper dust.

lines.zh: 你别站我后头，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Don't stand behind me. I don't like it.
I hug the basket and shrink back.
Copper spilled. That stings.
My nose is bleeding.
The cave wall is cold. I lean on it.

lines.zh: 洞穴的铜屑，撒进伤口里。
lines.en: Cave copper dust gets into the wound.
I check my back. The rope's snapped.
Now my ears are ringing.
I bite down and don't shout.
I don't want to die in a mine.
I still have to go up and report.
Is that copper in your hand?
I lean in and my eyes light up.
Better quality than what I dig.
The copper is shining. Let me see.
My fingers are colder than the copper.

lines.zh: 你要是换，我出三枚金币。
lines.en: If you're trading, I'll give three coins.
This would make a fine pick.
My hammer's gone blunt.
That shine reminds me of a forge.
One more look. Just one.

lines.zh: 那玩意儿在暗处也发亮。
lines.en: That thing shines even in the dark.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸自己的铜块，比不上。
lines.en: I feel my own copper. It's not as good.

lines.zh: 你放地上，我数金币给你。
lines.en: Set it down and I'll count out coins.
This is all I've got. Take it.

lines.zh: 我这人见了好矿走不动。
lines.en: Good ore stops my feet dead.

lines.zh: 让我拿锤子敲一下听听声。
lines.en: Let me tap it with my hammer and hear it.
Hey, my basket!

lines.zh: 铜块掉了一地，我赶紧捡。
lines.en: Copper spilled everywhere. I scramble for it.

lines.zh: 我比你想的矮，你差点踩到我。
lines.en: I'm shorter than you think. You nearly stepped on me.
Don't shove. This is a mine tunnel.
I back two steps against the wall.
You knocked my hammer.
My shoulder's gone numb a little.
The way's narrow; we'll have to edge past.
I'll step aside. Go on.
That's slag under your feet. Slippery.

lines.zh: 我这种人，一天到晚在洞里。
lines.en: My sort spend all day in the tunnels.
First, let's see if you can mine.

lines.zh: 我篓子里有一半能分你。
lines.en: Half this basket could be yours.

lines.zh: 洞里又黑又冷，两个人好些。
lines.en: The cave is dark and cold. Two is better.

lines.zh: 我这鼻子是铜锈染的，别嫌。
lines.en: My nose is stained with verdigris. Don't mind it.
We'll guard this vein together.
Are you afraid of the dark? I'm a little.
Don't tell anyone where this vein is.
Later we'll go up together.
I am blunt, but I do not lie.
Good copper, this.
I weigh it. Heavy.

lines.zh: 地上掉的都归发现的人。
lines.en: Fallen ore goes to whoever finds it.
I tuck it at the bottom of the basket.
This one's got verdigris. Needs a wipe.

lines.zh: 我的手指夹不住，掉了两次。
lines.en: My fingers can't hold it. Dropped it twice.
Enough here for a dagger.

lines.zh: 我把矿石堆在一起，数了数。
lines.en: I heap the ore and count.

lines.zh: 掉在轨道中间，差点让车压了。
lines.en: It lay between the rails; a cart nearly crushed it.
This copper buys me a meal.
A noise over there. I stop.
I raise the lamp a little.

lines.zh: 你的影子把矿道堵住了。
lines.en: Your shadow blocks the tunnel.

lines.zh: 这条道只有我走，你从哪来？
lines.en: Only I use this tunnel. Where did you come from?
I grip the hammer's haft.
I hear more than one set of steps.

lines.zh: 你先动手的话，我就喊人。
lines.en: If you swing first, I'll shout for the others.

lines.zh: 洞里的回声让我分不清远近。
lines.en: The echo makes distance hard to judge.
I'm watching you. Don't come closer.
That smell is from outside.
I hug the mine wall, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的灯太亮，我把它遮住。
lines.en: My lamp's too bright; I shade it.
Your step forward, my step back.
I know this side tunnel. You don't.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，在左前方。
lines.en: I count your steps. Ahead and left.
A cart stands between us.
I'm looking for something to throw.
One more step and I blow the whistle.
The water covers some of the noise.

lines.zh: 我往低处退，那里岔路多。
lines.en: I retreat lower where the tunnels branch.
I swing the hammer at your knee.
Both fists come down together.
I'm short, so I go for the legs.

lines.zh: 我抓了把矿渣扔你脸上。
lines.en: I fling a fistful of slag in your face.

lines.zh: 打中了一下，我自己也退了。
lines.en: I landed one and backed off myself.
My hammer is heavier than it looks.

lines.zh: 你砍在矿车上，声音很响。
lines.en: You struck the cart. Loud.

lines.zh: 我一边打一边往岔道退。
lines.en: I fight while backing toward the side tunnel.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我喊一声就来一群。
lines.en: Don't push me. One shout brings the rest.

lines.zh: 这一下我把你逼退了两步。
lines.en: That drove you back two paces.

lines.zh: 我从矿道的岔口钻出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a side tunnel.

lines.zh: 这里的铜矿，我早就看上了。
lines.en: I had my eye on this copper long ago.
I set my basket down.
Dark in here. Let me light the lamp first.
I cough twice. All dust.
I found this tunnel first.
I feel the wall for a vein.

lines.zh: 上面那些家伙，懒得下来。
lines.en: The ones above can't be bothered to come down.

lines.zh: 我落地时踩碎了一块矿渣。
lines.en: I land and crush a lump of slag.
The smell of copper settles me.
A chunk of raw copper sits in my pocket.

lines.zh: 我从矿架上掉下来，砸在矿渣上。
lines.en: I fall off the scaffolding onto the slag.

lines.zh: 洞里积水太深，我扒不住。
lines.en: The flooded shaft is too deep; I can't hold on.
Copper rust smears my face.
An arrow sticks in my basket.
That light makes my eyes swim.

lines.zh: 面包吃完了，我挖得没力气。
lines.en: Out of bread, I've no strength to dig.

lines.zh: 雷顺着矿道打下来，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning comes down the shaft and I go numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有矿，也没有底。
lines.en: No ore in the void, and no bottom.
